pages.text: A program starts at line 0 with a PROGRAM block and a LABEL with its name. The name must be unique in the whole c0de dimension. Line 1 must be a NOOP line.

After that, INCLUDE lines may follow. They load libraries, like $(1)INCLUDE c0de/math$(). Then come struct types, global variables, constants and functions, in any order.$(br2)A name can only be used after it was defined. So put everything a function needs above it. The program ends at the first empty line.
